another header than its caller) resolved to nothing there and counted
as an integer: the float went to no register, the callee got the
caller's own integer argument cast to float, and a float result read
back as 0. In the NTSC decomp this broke every rotation about an…

commits.author: Veradictus

centred and scaled lines) took the font's TEX0 as an s32 and passed it

holds the whole word and the routine only moves it (daddu into $20,

the port the C's types are what runs, and the word came back with its
upper half sign-extended (CBP 0x3FFF, TH 15). The parameter is now s64
and the…

commits.author: Veradictus

US, chosen by the card's serial. A file is the two section sizes, a global
section and 20 planet sections; a section is {size, crc16},…

start point (no position is saved). So moving a save is chunk 0, with the

commits.author: Veradictus

function the loaded level has under another name.

commits.headline: fix(rac1/pal): func_001F9E58 returns the value its callers read
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
From the priority pass: retail leaves a result in $v0 that callers use;
callees.h declared it void, so the port gave them 0. OpenRAC only (the
matching tree keeps its declaration). Port build and ctest pass.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.headline: fix(port): controllers keep working after Quit Game
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
scePad2CreateSocket handed out 0, 1, 2... and the port reads a socket as
its controller port. rac1 sets its pads up again when it returns to the
boot screen after Quit Game, so the second setup got socket 1, the empty
second port, and no button reached the menus. The socket is now the port
the parameters name (rac1 writes {2, port}).

Checked by script on PAL: Novalis, pause, Options, Quit Game, Yes; the boot
notice now takes a button, the title shows and Start opens the main menu
(before:…

commits.headline: fix(port): Quit Game puts the executable's program back for the menus
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
After Quit Game (Options, Quit Game, Yes) the main menu's three boxes
came back empty, and the log had calls to 0x00208BB8, 0x0021B338 and
0x0021B958 (overlay -1), none of them a function's start.

On the way out of a level, the level's loader reads the boot program
back from the disc (func_00204BE8, the disc table's entry at +0x4F8)
and ParseBin copies it in, with the executable's entry, 0x001E99D8.
That copy is another build of the executable's program: the same
sections at the same…

commits.headline: ci: publish a launcher draft once its build and checks pass
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
A new workflow, publish, runs when the launcher or checks workflow
completes. It publishes the newest launcher-v* draft when the tag's
installer build succeeded, the latest checks run on master passed, and
launcher/release-notes/<version>.md exists on master (its text becomes the
release notes). Without a notes file the draft stays for publishing by hand.
Adds the notes for 0.7.1.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
